prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference 1 is the original illustrated edition: extract and redraw ONLY its central illustration. Reference 2 is an approved standalone flat illustration and defines the required finish, cutout treatment, palette and ink texture. Make a straight-on 2D print illustration for a software edition, on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Use deep navy, pale citron and vivid orange with fine stippled printmaking texture. Remove the physical book/box completely: no software packaging, spine, cover rectangle, paper ground, title band, title or publisher text, logo, frame or ground shadow. The motif itself may retain illustrated object depth; the overall artwork must be flat front-facing printed artwork with no packaging perspective. Center the complete isolated motif with comfortable transparent margins, filling about 85% of the canvas. No lettering or numbers anywhere. Preserve opaque colored ink inside the motif, actual alpha outside and through clear gaps. Output PNG square 1024x1024. Motif: one large retro processor chip with metallic pins, branching navy circuit traces and instruction-encoding strips of small segmented cells with several orange cells. Keep the chip dominant; redraw circuit traces as an isolated graphic with no rectangular circuit-board or cover backing.
